paragraphs: My name is Denis Ionuț Mărginaș, I'm {{age}} years old, and I have experience as a full-stack web developer. I am passionate about technology and creativity, always seeking to expand my skills and expertise in web development, staying curious about the latest innovations.

Before entering the web development industry, I focused on video editing, specifically for video games. My interest in cinematic executions and angles led to freelance opportunities where I honed my skills. With a strong background in Mathematics and Informatics, I eventually shifted my focus to web development, which has since become my main area of expertise. In my free time, I enjoy building computer hardware, playing video games, cycling, and playing tennis.

Looking ahead, I aim to continue growing as a developer, stay updated with the latest technologies, and make a significant impact in the tech industry. When I’m not coding, I enjoy gaming and exploring new technologies that inspire my work.

text: Before web development, I worked as a freelance video editor, mostly editing gaming videos. After finishing my university studies in Mathematics and Informatics, I moved into web development and made it my career.

In 2019 I joined Pia Soft Product as a web developer and photo-video editor. I built presentation websites and online shops on WordPress and PrestaShop, handled SEO, website and hosting maintenance and client communication, and designed banners, logos and video ads. Apart from video editing, which I already knew, I learned everything on the job, working independently and building web applications with PHP, Smarty TPL, SQL, JavaScript, jQuery, HTML and CSS.

At the end of 2021 I moved full time to Netex Romania as a front-end developer, while staying part time at Pia Soft Product until late 2022. I maintained several WordPress websites and turned designs from Zeplin into static pages with HTML, SASS, Node.js, Bootstrap, JavaScript and jQuery. I started on my part of the project alone and later worked alongside a colleague, which taught me GitLab, Git and how to work well in a team.

In 2023 I took on shorter roles, as a junior WordPress developer at Enlivy and building a custom WordPress theme for Yes Agency. Since 2024 I have been working with Mentor Marketing Experts as a WordPress developer and web page designer, building Elementor websites from Figma designs, through Gi Group since April 2026.

seo.description: Learn how we collect, use, and protect your personal data. Our Privacy Policy explains our use of cookies, Google Analytics, and your rights regarding your data.

paragraphs: We use Google Analytics on this website to analyze and understand how visitors interact with our site. Google Analytics is a web analytics service provided by Google Inc. It helps us track and report website traffic, allowing us to improve our content and user experience based on data collected.

Google Analytics collects data about your visit, including your IP address, browser type, and the pages you view. This information is used to generate reports on website activity and user behavior. The data collected by Google Analytics is aggregated and anonymized, meaning it does not personally identify you.

The information collected through Google Analytics helps us understand how users navigate our site, which pages are popular, and how we can enhance our website's performance. We use this data to make informed decisions about our content and services, aiming to provide a better experience for our visitors.

You can choose to opt-out of Google Analytics tracking by installing the Google Analytics Opt-out Browser Add-on or by disabling cookies in your browser settings. Please note that opting out may affect your experience on our website.
For more details on how Google Analytics handles your data, you can refer to Google's Privacy Policy.
You can change your choice at any time: open the cookie settings and switch Google Analytics on or off for this browser. Turning it off stops the tracking and removes the Google Analytics cookies.
